text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I walked past the school gates—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Disciplinary Committee Chairman Bamboo Memory...!
Is she cracking down on rules or something?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that face look kinda demonic?
They look suuuper strict about checking dress code violations...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hey there!
You're a trainer at the academy, right!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sir, no, sir! We received reports of a suspicious woman
in a lab coat wearing a mask on school grounds,
so I've been keeping watch!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thanks! But as a morals committee member, keeping peace among the students is my sworn duty!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —E-Emergency, Class Rep!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship suddenly started practicing air giant swings right in the middle of the central plaza...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That Golshi, stirring up another bizarre commotion!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what if you got dizzy, tripped,
and hurt yourself? Sheesh.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll go stop 'em!
choice_data_list: Maintaining discipline sure is tough, huh.
Maintaining discipline must be pretty tough, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll go stop 'em!
choice_data_list: Maintaining discipline sure is tough, huh.
Maintaining discipline must be pretty tough, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine!
This much is nothin' for me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Besides, trouble is just proof
that everyone's bursting with energy, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, us Disciplinary Committee members
will keep our eyes peeled so she doesn't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Though having people get spooked of me 'cause of it kinda stinks, heheh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Flashing a warm, friendly smile, Bamboo Memory sprinted off.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Understood! It'll take no time at all
if we head straight to the plaza from here!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Um, if it wouldn't be too much trouble, it'd really
help if you could keep watch here in my place!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, I owe ya one!
—Please take good care of me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! On my honor as the Demon Disciplinary Chair,
I'm gonna give it everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa, please wait up, Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Bamboo Memory dashed toward the scene, the disciplinary committee members scrambled to chase after her.
